mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate acute consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) triggers Federal Reserve accommodative policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust supply chain activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO rises over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 650.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signals housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 650.0 for 2 months).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) trend over the prior 3 months indicates improving job market conditions, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% for two consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y for 2 months).
